project.name: ai_slop_gate
project.goal: Deterministic, cacheable analysis pipeline for code, infra and AI-based evaluations
project.main_risk: loss of architectural invariants across iterations and chat sessions

global_principles: No hidden coupling between run, init, policy and providers
Caching must be transparent and reproducible

separation_of_concerns.run: orchestration only, no init, no policy loading

cached_provider_contract.responsibility: cache results of provider method calls
rules: No decision which method to call

providers.common_rule: Provider may implement collect() or analyze() or both

pipeline_execution.rule: If provider has analyze() -> use analyze, else collect

6.1.name: CachedProvider smoke test
6.1.status: contract defined, needs simple smoke test only

6.3.2.name: run/init/policy normalization
6.3.2.status: identified as problematic, not yet refactored

explicit_non_goals: Do not mix init and run
known_problems: run() previously mixed orchestration, init and policy logic
loss of context between chat sessions caused architectural drift
CachedProvider v1 cached only collect(), not analyze()
next_allowed_steps: Implement CachedProvider v2 exactly as per contract
Add minimal smoke test proving cache hit
Refactor run() strictly after CachedProvider is stable
